title: Evidence of political bias in search engines and language models before major elections

bias_targets.methodology: Deploying automated bots with residential proxies to issue neutral election-related queries to search engines and LLMs, extracting mentions of political entities, parties, and issues from the results, mapping them to ideological leanings or partisan importance, and measuring over/under-representation by comparing these mention frequencies against external baselines such as past election outcomes, polling data, and media salience.
